text.title: 楼上那个困难的月份
text.situation:
十月，停在橱窗前的人少了。本地店主谈到经济下行，但米娜无法仅凭清静的一周判断整个经济是否衰退。她眼前的问题是缝纫机坏了。交房租前就买新机器，可能危及小店撑过这个月的能力。杰伊把维修报价带到楼上，努尔带来十月订单本。机器故障成为危机，因为承诺的几个包还没完成。有些耽搁无法避免，假装没有问题只会让顾客继续等。他们找到一位维修师傅，周五能来检查机器。米娜划掉猜测的完工日期，整个下午打电话。店里很静，楼上电话却没闲下来。

努尔：我们要关店了吗？
米娜：还不知道。现在买新机器，可能影响交房租。
杰伊：维修师傅周五能来。
米娜：那我们可以告诉顾客检查日期，不必承诺每个包的完成日期。

paragraphs.en: In October, fewer people stopped at the window. Local shopkeepers spoke of an economic downturn, but Mina could not tell from one quiet week whether the wider economy was in recession. Her immediate problem was a broken sewing machine. Replacing it before paying the rent could jeopardize the shop’s ability to survive the month. Jay brought the repair estimates upstairs, and Noor brought the October order book. The machine failure had become a crisis because several promised bags were unfinished. Some delay was inevitable; pretending otherwise would only leave customers waiting. They found a repairer who could inspect the machine on Friday. Mina crossed out the guessed completion dates and spent the afternoon making calls. The shop was quiet, but the upstairs telephone was not.

paragraphs.en:
Noor: Are we closing?
Mina: I do not know yet. Paying for a new machine now could jeopardize the rent payment.
Jay: The repairer can come on Friday.
Mina: Then we can give people that date for the inspection, without promising a date for every finished bag.

S08.Q16.P01.cue: 说说这个月为什么困难。
acceptableAnswers: 米娜希望小店撑过困难的月份。 本地店主谈到经济下行。

S08.Q16.P02.cue: 说说危机和能确认的信息。
acceptableAnswers: 米娜无法判断整个经济是否处于衰退。 机器故障成了小店的危机。

S08.Q16.P03.cue: 说明什么耽搁不可避免，以及什么面临风险。
acceptableAnswers: 机器坏后，有些耽搁无法避免。 立刻买机器可能危及房租支付。

S08.Q16.T01.cue: 迟迟作决定可能使项目面临风险，怎么说？
